newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank active in peso market.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank active in peso market.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank continued to intervene in the currency market on Friday after raising its overnight borrowing rate to 20 percent from 13 percent, traders said.

Traders said the Central Bank has been buying dollars at 26.356/26.357 for delivery today and at 26.371/26.372 for delivery on Monday. At the same time, it was also selling dollars at 26.375, one said.
Philippine Central Bank active in peso market =2
Turnover in the foreign exchange market had already swelled to a record $613 million late on Friday.
It surpassed the previous volume record of $446.3 million on January 9 when the peso was hit by a sharp fall in interest rates after a reserve requirement cut.
The peso has been reeling from the spillover effect of the Thai baht's problems. This has forced the Central Bank to raise its key overnight borrowing rate by 8.75 percentage points in two days.
